skill.name: wap-ingestion
skill.description: Guides S3 data ingestion into Bauplan using a temporary branch, audit checks, and controlled publish behavior.
skill.summary: Guides safe S3 ingestion into Bauplan with a Write-Audit-Publish workflow.
skill.author: BauplanLabs

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown backtick false positives around inline code, SDK method names, and fenced examples. The real risks are the instructions to run a generated Python ingestion script and Bauplan CLI merge commands, which can modify branches or publish data. No prompt injection or hidden malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running generated Python scripts, and validate table names and S3 paths before execution.

remediation.issue: Bauplan CLI merge and branch deletion commands
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before merge or branch removal commands, and display the exact branch and target before running them.

content.user_title: Ingest S3 Data with Bauplan WAP
content.value_statement: Loading S3 data can risk broken tables or unreviewed production changes. This skill guides a branch based WAP flow with checks before publishing.
actual_capabilities: Collects S3 path, table name, and branch cleanup preferences before scripting.
Guides creation of a Bauplan temporary branch from main.
Uses the Bauplan SDK to create or append tables from S3 data.
Adds a row count audit before publish decisions.
Supports inspect-first or automatic merge behavior after a successful load.
Provides CLI merge steps after manual inspection.
limitations: Requires a configured Bauplan Python SDK and valid workspace credentials.
Requires S3 paths that Bauplan can access.
Does not design custom data quality rules beyond row count checks.
Can modify main when automatic merge or CLI merge options are used.

use_cases.title: Load a New S3 Dataset
use_cases.description: Create a Bauplan table from Parquet, CSV, or JSONL files while keeping changes on a temporary branch.

use_cases.title: Review Data Before Publishing
use_cases.description: Import data, run a row count audit, and leave the branch open for inspection before merge.

use_cases.title: Append Batch Files Safely
use_cases.description: Append new S3 files to an existing table without touching main until the audit passes.

prompt_templates.title: Start a New Ingestion
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new table load.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me ingest S3 data into Bauplan with WAP. Ask me for the S3 path, table name, success behavior, and failure behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Inspect First Load
prompt_templates.scenario: Keep the branch open after a successful import.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a WAP ingestion plan for my S3 dataset. Keep the branch open after the row count audit so I can inspect it.

prompt_templates.title: Append to an Existing Table
prompt_templates.scenario: Use WAP for an existing table instead of creating a new one.
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through appending S3 files to an existing Bauplan table with WAP. Do not publish until I confirm the audit result.

prompt_templates.title: Publish After Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow after a successful inspect-first run.
prompt_templates.prompt: I inspected the WAP branch and want to publish it. Show the exact merge steps and ask for confirmation before any command runs.

output_examples.input: Request: ingest monthly order files from S3 into a new Bauplan table.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks for the S3 path, target table, and branch handling choices, then prepares an inspect-first WAP workflow.

output_examples.input: Request: append new event files to an existing table and keep the branch for review.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares an append workflow, runs a row count audit, and reports the branch name for inspection.

output_examples.input: Request: publish a WAP branch after review.
output_examples.output: The assistant shows the target branch and merge action, then asks for explicit confirmation before running publish steps.

best_practices: Use inspect-first mode when loading new datasets or changing table structure.
Confirm the S3 path, table name, and namespace before running the ingestion script.
Review the branch and row count before merging changes into main.
anti_patterns: Do not merge to main before checking that rows were imported.
Do not reuse old temporary branch names for new ingestion runs.
Do not run branch deletion commands until the published result is verified.

faq.question: What does WAP mean?
faq.answer: WAP means Write, Audit, Publish. Data is written to a branch, checked, and published only after review.

faq.question: Does this skill create Bauplan tables?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide table creation from S3 data through the Bauplan SDK.

faq.question: Can it append data to an existing table?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for importing new S3 files into an existing table on a branch.

faq.question: Does it publish data automatically?
faq.answer: Only when the user selects merge behavior. The default path keeps the branch open for inspection.

faq.question: What audit does the template perform?
faq.answer: The template checks that the imported table has more than zero rows before publish steps continue.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: The environment needs Bauplan access and permission to read the source S3 data.
